# Cyber Kings (2026-11-17): Hegemonic Ambitions. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/hegemonies/gen_ambitions.py - change the generator, not this file.
# Ambition CBs: only while the attacker holds the matching Hegemonic Ambition. Modelled on the Unite CBs (cyber_kings_unite_cbs.txt)
# but county and duchy only, no de jure absorption (the hegemony does not exist yet), and invalidated if the attacker dies.

ck_ambition_terra_county_cb = {
	icon = individual_county_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_terra }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = county
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_county
			ck_ambition_county_in_terra = yes
			holder ?= {
				OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_TERRA_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_TERRA_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_AMBITION_TERRA_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 96
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_ambition_terra_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_terra }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = duchy
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { ck_ambition_county_in_terra = yes }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}

ck_ambition_celestial_county_cb = {
	icon = individual_county_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_celestial }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = county
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_county
			ck_ambition_county_in_celestial = yes
			holder ?= {
				OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_CELESTIAL_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_CELESTIAL_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_AMBITION_CELESTIAL_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 96
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_ambition_celestial_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_celestial }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = duchy
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { ck_ambition_county_in_celestial = yes }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_CELESTIAL_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_CELESTIAL_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_AMBITION_CELESTIAL_DUCHY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 96
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_ambition_eurasia_county_cb = {
	icon = individual_county_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_eurasia }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = county
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_county
			ck_ambition_county_in_eurasia = yes
			holder ?= {
				OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_EURASIA_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_EURASIA_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_AMBITION_EURASIA_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 96
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_ambition_eurasia_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_eurasia }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = duchy
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { ck_ambition_county_in_eurasia = yes }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_EURASIA_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_EURASIA_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"

	target_title_tier = county
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_county
			ck_ambition_county_in_gondwana = yes
			holder ?= {
				OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_GONDWANA_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_GONDWANA_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_AMBITION_GONDWANA_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 96
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_ambition_gondwana_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_gondwana }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = duchy
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { ck_ambition_county_in_gondwana = yes }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles

		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_GONDWANA_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_GONDWANA_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"

				OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_MARS_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_MARS_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_AMBITION_MARS_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 96
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_ambition_mars_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_mars }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = duchy
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { ck_ambition_county_in_mars = yes }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {

			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target

			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {

				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_MOON_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_MOON_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_AMBITION_MOON_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 96
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_ambition_moon_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_moon }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = duchy
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { ck_ambition_county_in_moon = yes }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }

	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer

	defender_allies_inherit = yes

		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = invalidate
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "CK_AMBITION_OUTER_MOONS_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_OUTER_MOONS_COUNTY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "CK_AMBITION_OUTER_MOONS_COUNTY_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 96
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150

	ai_score_mult = { value = 1 }
}

ck_ambition_outer_moons_duchy_cb = {
	icon = individual_duchy_de_jure_cb
	group = de_jure
	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }

	allowed_for_character = {
		scope:attacker = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_outer_moons }
	}
	allowed_against_character = {
		NOR = {
			scope:defender = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:attacker }
			scope:attacker = { target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender }
			scope:defender = scope:attacker
		}
	}
	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = duchy
	target_de_jure_regions_above = yes
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			tier = tier_duchy
			title_capital_county ?= { ck_ambition_county_in_outer_moons = yes }
			any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
				tier = tier_county
				holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				every_in_list = {
					list = target_titles
					every_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
						limit = {
							tier = tier_county
							OR = {
								holder.top_liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender
								holder.liege = scope:defender.liege
							}
						}
						add = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_per_county
					}
				}
				desc = CB_CLAIM_COST_TARGET_TITLES
			}
			max = ck_ambition_cb_prestige_max
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = { on_declared_war = yes }

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder ?= {
					OR = {
						this = scope:defender
						target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
					}
				}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_invalidated_desc = msg_invalidate_war_title
	on_invalidated = { }

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}
	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			change = scope:change
			title = scope:target
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}
	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_defender
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = de_jure_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}
	on_defeat = {
		scope:attacker = { show_pow_release_message_effect = yes }
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = { GOLD_VALUE = 10 }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			save_temporary_scope_as = target
		}
		setup_de_jure_cb = {
			attacker = scope:attacker
			defender = scope:defender
			victory = no
			title = scope:target
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	transfer_behavior = transfer
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name_base = "CK_AMBITION_OUTER_MOONS_DUCHY_CB_WAR_NAME_BASE"
